scope: Android; 640px YOLO model unchanged; no latency rejection limit
changes: Dedicated inference worker with one in-flight frame through delivery
Native OpenCV LK optical flow; up to 20 points per vehicle and 160 background points, capped at 400
384px motion luma retained; transferred as Uint8Array to native-owned ByteArray
Avoid duplicate 4.9MB tensor copy; GPUFrame retained through processing
No attached photo output while preview visible; on-demand preview snapshot
Generic signal colour heuristic skipped on Android; default BDD detector does not run segmentation
Developer telemetry sampled at 1Hz; pipeline timings at 2Hz

observations.method: Individual on-device readings, different ordinary indoor scenes; not a controlled traffic benchmark.

video_evidence.note: No manual ground truth; per-frame evidence coverage, not alert accuracy. Desktop worker timing excludes model and bridge.

limitations: Replay uses BDD PyTorch weights at 640px, not the exact TFLite runtime
Video evidence counts have no manual labels; they are not accuracy scores
IMG_8501 night footage produced very little supported motion evidence; field validation remains necessary
